component.name: GarageLog
component.summary: Track fuel, maintenance and costs of your vehicles
Tanken, Wartung und Kosten deiner Fahrzeuge erfassen

description.p: Your car knows exactly how much it costs you. Now you can know too. GarageLog is a private logbook for cars, motorcycles, scooters and electric vehicles: fuel and charging, service, maintenance intervals and costs, all in one file on your computer. No account, no cloud, no tracking. The only one keeping an eye on your fuel consumption is you.

Dein Auto weiß ganz genau, was es dich kostet. Jetzt weißt du es auch. GarageLog ist ein privates Logbuch für Autos, Motorräder, Roller und Elektrofahrzeuge: Tanken und Laden, Service, Wartungsintervalle und Kosten, alles in einer Datei auf deinem Rechner. Kein Konto, keine Cloud, kein Tracking. Deinen Verbrauch beobachtest nur du.

ul.li: Fuel and charging entries with consumption between two full tanks
Tank- und Ladeeinträge mit Verbrauch zwischen zwei Volltankungen
Service history with categories, workshop and receipts, so "when did we last change the oil?" is no longer a family debate
Servicehistorie mit Kategorien, Werkstatt und Belegen, damit „Wann war eigentlich der letzte Ölwechsel?“ keine Familiendiskussion mehr wird
Maintenance intervals by distance and time that speak up before the warning light does
Wartungsintervalle nach Strecke und Zeit, die sich melden, bevor es die Warnleuchte tut
Statistics: total cost, cost per kilometre and month, consumption chart (not for the faint of heart)
Statistik: Gesamtkosten, Kosten pro Kilometer und Monat, Verbrauchskurve (für starke Nerven)
Export to JSON and CSV, import of fuel entries from CSV
Export als JSON und CSV, Import von Tankeinträgen aus CSV
Kilometres or miles, litres or gallons, any currency symbol
Kilometer oder Meilen, Liter oder Gallonen, beliebiges Währungssymbol

description.p: A new look and many robustness fixes.

ul.li: Redesigned vehicle page with a summary card, own icons per vehicle type, a due list grouped by status and statistics tiles
The odometer value of a vehicle is now a minimum reading, so a starting value is no longer added to later entries
Forms save or close only once per key press; the computed price field uses the current input
Safer files: checked attachment names, atomic "Save As", private file permissions, CSV export protected against formula injection
Faster statistics and CSV import preview

description.p: Garages opened with 1.1.0 are upgraded to a new file format and can no longer be opened with 1.0.x.
New screenshots of the real application window; no changes to the app itself.
First release: fuel and charging log, service history with attachments, maintenance intervals with due reminders, statistics, JSON/CSV export and CSV import, English and German.
